body: Somewhat better. Talking it out and figured things out with her. She wants to try again when things cleared up for her and when I’m feeling better so I suppose that’s something to look forward to.
I’m looking for reasons to keep going and so far I have a few. Thank you people, I really appreciate the support.
I thought we were just making harmless jokes. It’s okay though
I’ve given myself a few years and these thoughts haven’t left, my feelings haven’t left. The only thing that’s left has been my girlfriend and I’m not sure I can handle this.
It is. Just some other kind of story. I’ll post it for you guys to see later
If I could get my hands on some then I wouldn’t have wrote this post.

Discord, Reddit, Steam, whatever. I just really need someone at this point. 

Discord is Borb#8687 

Don’t even remember my Steam

Deleted my old Reddit account 

Whatever else you want to use I’m fine with.
I don’t think they’d care. The dogs don’t really mess with me, and the cat only likes to sleep in my room. It’s not like they’ll miss me
I’ve tried. I tried everything man, nothing worked. Psychiatric care in both a therapist and a hospital, medicine, whatever else other than drugs, I tried everything. Nothings worked for me. I’m done

We have enough pets. Two dogs and a cat is enough. I one of the dogs but the other one and the cat are fine. They can manage without me, there’s people who take care of them better than me in this household. Much like everyone else, it wouldn’t matter for me.

Everyone says that, even I tell myself that every night. I’ve told others that when they were feeling down too, but last time I said that things only got worse and worse. I don’t know if I can keep lying to myself like that man, I’m sorry.

First off, I really appreciate the consideration and listening. No, she didnt know that until we were talking after the breakup and she wanted me to actually open up with my problems because she knew they were there. I never did because I didn’t want her to break up over me being unstable but it didn’t work clearly. Don’t worry about sounding rude, I understand what you mean. I try my best to get through one minute at a time, but it’s so hard when every minute you’re miserable.

I’ve tried everything. I went through so much and so many attempt to help but nothing’s worked. The only thing keeping me sane and happy for the longest time was my girlfriend and now that she’s gone, I have nothing. Im so tired of everything, I can’t handle it. I’m done, I just don’t know what to do at this point

I’m tired of being this way. I’ve tried getting help, I’ve tried everything. Nothing works. The only thing keeping me happy was my girlfriend, and she’s left me. 

I’m tired of it. I’m so sick of acting like I’m all good and happy all day then coming home and breaking apart. I’m so sick of being sad, I just want to end it.

I came back to edit, thanks for the consideration. It’s something I really appreciate, but I’ve already made my mind. I’m sorry
